_comment: Audio manifest (PROPOSED). Paths are relative to /static/audio/. Every room plays the base layers plus its own layer, all looping. Volumes are starting points in 0-1; files are already level-matched (music -20/-24 dBFS RMS, ambience -28 to -36, one-shots peak -4.5). Prompts and logs: prompts/assets/music, prompts/assets/sfx, CHANGELOG.md.

ambience._rooms_without_own_layer: medical_bay, crew_quarters, editing_room, cabins, corridors and stairs play the base layers only
